method: Exact exhaustive prime-log certification through four variables; tensor additivity; analytic Walsh classification of clique-quadratic and general quadratic bent phases through affine parity-hyperplane child spectra.
prior_status: sum_i KL_i^U<=sum_i JS_i^H was refuted by an exact four-bit all-depth tensor family; no corrected aI+bU theorem had been proved on a new broad class.
mathematical_delta: G<=11I/4 is exact and sharp on arbitrary products of all <=4-bit Boolean factors. More substantially, the restriction-closed tensor class of arbitrary-size dense clique-quadratic blocks satisfies the parameter-free sharp-supremum G<=3I. Every quadratic bent phase has exact G/I=3-(2/n)sum_i2^{-r_i}. This removes total dimension, block dimension, block count and dense quadratic overlap within the stated class, but not arbitrary coherent plateaued unions.
